purpose: Selected SI hand-centric BiGRU + CTC checkpoint for backend handoff
git_policy: The repository-wide *.pt rule ignores this checkpoint. Do not rely on Git distribution or commit it without explicit Git LFS approval.
delivery_method: Download the checkpoint from artifact_url to download_path and verify the SHA-256 checksum before use. No retraining is required.
selection_scope: Checkpoint selected using SI train/dev only; final held-out SI test evaluation was completed after freezing and was not used for model selection.
